messages:
lucy: Quick one for month-end  we invoiced Customer X for an annual commit (USD 360,000) on 2026-06-03. Contract split: $60k onboarding services (one-time) and $300k subscription (12 months). Need revenue schedule for June close.

maya: Do we have the contract and sales allocation?

lucy: Contract uploaded to deal record: contract_CUSTX_2026-06-01.pdf. Sales confirmed the split.

jorge: Services delivery window is Jun-Aug per Sales. Should services be recognized over 3 months?

ashley: If services are distinct and delivered over time, yes 
recognize pro rata over 3 months. Subscription ratable over 12 months from June.

paul: Proposed deferrals: services $60,000 / 3 = $20,000/mo; subscription $300,000 / 12 = $25,000/mo. Initial invoice JE moves billing to deferred revenue.

lucy: Draft invoice JE (2026-06-03):
DR 1020-Cash/AR $360,000
CR 2310-Deferred Revenue $360,000
Memo: Annual commit billing - Customer X.

maya: Monthly recognition for June (6/30): DR 2310-Deferred Revenue $45,000; CR 4000-Services Revenue $20,000; CR 4010-Subscription Revenue $25,000.

ashley: Ensure GL mapping matches revenue subaccounts. Also include narrative in RevRec entry noting 3-month service delivery.

paul: Tax note: services are taxable in customer's jurisdiction and tax was collected on invoice. No separate tax JE at recognition, but tag the invoice date in tax memo.

jorge: ARR/MRR policy reminder: Sales records ACV on signing; Finance records MRR as recognized subscription revenue ($25k/mo). Add note to close pack.

acct-bot: Attachments: invoice_1956123456_CUSTX.pdf, contract_CUSTX_2026-06-01.pdf (automated).

lucy: Requesting RevOps/Revenue owner sign-off. @ashley please approve so we can create schedules in RevRec system.

ashley: Approved. Post schedules and attach contract, invoice, and sales approval email for audit.

maya: I'll create schedules and post the deferral JE by 5pm PT. Will update this thread when done. :white_check_mark:
